scripts.build:artifact: tsc --noEmit && VITE_TARGET=artifact BASE_PATH=./ vite build --outDir dist-artifact && node scripts/build-artifact.mjs
scripts.fetch:whisper: mkdir -p .whisper-cache/onnx && cd .whisper-cache && for f in config.json generation_config.json preprocessor_config.json tokenizer.json tokenizer_config.json onnx/encoder_model_quantized.onnx onnx/decoder_model_merged_quantized.onnx; do [ -s $f ] || curl -sfL -o $f https://huggingface.co/Xenova/whisper-tiny.en/resolve/main/$f; done
